And V_0 of (4.7) IS defined — SlowDivergence.radialFlux h 0 (SlowDivergence.lean:21) — so clause (i)'s V_0/X smoothness and clause (v)'s V_0 = 0 follow from stated declarations by instantiation. Relation partial, all findings low.

findings.summary: V_0 of (4.7) is SlowDivergence.radialFlux h 0 (SlowDivergence.lean:21). No declaration writes clause (v)'s V_0 = 0 on [X_v, ∞) as such; it is a four-step composition of stated declarations. Packaging only.
(4.25) is stated for v.profiles only in the exterior X ≥ nominalOuterX W, and for all X ≥ 0 only for the nominal W; (4.28) is stated for W alone, and the transfer lemma to v does not apply.

Clause (iii) asserts that n extends smoothly to the closed annulus including X = X_a, X_b. The Lean closed-annulus direction is only ContinuousOn; C^∞ regularity is stated separately on the two edge collars, and the gluing is stated nowhere.

Clause (i)'s uniform bounds on every fixed mixed (X,η)-derivative over each [0,R] × [−1,1] are stated by no declaration found; Lean gives ContDiffOn on an open domain, which does not by itself yield bounds on a closed slab.

Clause (iii)'s uniform data — positive lower bounds for F, a, v_s−2 and a single κ ∈ (0,2) in (4.26) — is stated, but as a compactness lemma plus pointwise cone lemmas in the target-cone variables (η, slopeRatio u); no declaration writes (4.26) with a κ.

The inner edge identity n(X_a,η) ∥ (a(X_a,η), −b_s(X_a,η)) is stated for the activation MODEL stress, not for the final one; the chart equality that would carry it over is stated, but the identification of referenceP1/referenceP2 with (a, −b_s) is not.
C > 1 is not exported. C is the free normalization W.axis.normalization, bounded below only by entranceNormalization, which is not shown to exceed 1; only normalization_pos is derived.

No single declaration bundles Theorem 4.6. exists_weighted_profile is the closest and asserts only clause (iv) plus the edge/collar part of (iii); the remaining clauses are separate lemmas, split over the nominal W and the modulated v.
